capabilities: calculate reading time for selected text or an entire note
create multiple WPM presets for reading, speaking, and presenting
switch between speed presets via a dropdown menu
display reading time, word count, and current speed
measure your personal WPM with a companion web app
extras: Desktop only; not supported on mobile. A companion web app is referenced for measuring personal WPM, but the link is stripped in the provided README.
motivation: The author created it to help creators and professionals master their content timing, for scripts and writing where timing matters.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to estimate reading or speaking duration for a text, so creators and speakers must guess how long their scripts will run.
summary: Reading time calculator that estimates how long selected text or a note takes to read or read aloud, using personalized words-per-minute presets.
